ageMetadata.sourceNote: Population between the ages 0 to 14 as a percentage of the total population. Population is based on the de facto definition of population.
ageMetadata.sourceOrganization: United Nations Population Division. World Population Prospects., United Nations Population Division, uri: https://population.un.org/wpp/, publisher: United Nations Population Division

ageMetadata.sourceOrganization: World Population Prospects, United Nations (UN), publisher: UN Population Division

ageMetadata.name: Population ages 65 and above (% of total population)

missingData: No cross-country or future-year imputation. UI retains null. Simulation uses an explicitly assumed neutral score of 50 when a normalized characteristic is missing.

normalization.education: UIS lower-secondary attainment percentage, population 25+; national proxy for all cohorts
normalization.economic: 100 * clamp(log(GNI per capita PPP constant 2021 international $ / 200) / log(90000/200), 0, 1)
normalization.urban: Density rank weighted to national World Bank urban share; digital urban/rural adjustment mean-preserving and constrained to 0..100. Other characteristics are not assigned invented urban/rural statistics.
